title: Remote, asynchronous training and feedback enables development of neurodynamic skills in physiotherapy students
reason: Single-group repeated measures of skill scores on uploaded practice videos across four remote sessions, plus perception survey. The scored videos are the achievement outcome itself; no separate indicator is related to success or a construct.

extraction.n_quote: Finally, data was collected and analyzed for 60 participants who completed the training and uploaded the four videos (total = 240 videos).
extraction.lms_indicators: uploaded performance videos scored by checklist/rubric (used as the outcome)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: neurodynamic technique performance scores across sessions; perceptions (self-report)
extraction.notes: No control group; change over sessions only.
